title: gates.yaml schema
description: Schema for speckit-gate gates.yaml configuration files.

prefix.description: Command prefix to strip when matching. Default: 'speckit.'

feature_root.description: Root directory for feature artefacts. Default: 'specs'

resolve.description: Feature resolution strategies in priority order.

no_feature.description: Block reason when no feature can be resolved.

gates.description: Map of command name to gate definition.

gate.description: Gate definition for a single spec-kit command.

deprecated.description: If true, this command is always blocked with a deprecation message.

spawn_agent.description: If true, a PreToolUse:Agent gate is registered (Claude Code only). Harnesses lacking Agent events skip this gate with a compile-time warning.

context.description: Advisory context text injected into the model alongside the gate result.
